description: Get a download link for a game's file (manual, schematic, ROM, parts list), as the signed-in member. The link is signed and works for about 5 minutes; fetch it right away. A member can request 20 file links an hour. Find file ids with list_game_files. Returns the file's name, format, size, the link (download_url) and how long it lasts (expires_in, seconds).

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

fileId.description: The file id from list_game_files, with or without its fil_ prefix.

gameId.description: The game: its slug (as list_game_files and get_my_downloads give it) or its id, with or without the gm_ prefix.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

name: kineticist_get_file_download_link
title: Get a file download link
